body:
## Pull request overview

Polishes report page rendering across the report plugin and console integration by introducing a shared value formatter, improving table UX, adding badge-based status rendering, and modernizing the loading state.

**Changes:**
- Added `formatValue` utility and applied it to summary cards and table cells (numbers, currency, percent, dates + ISO autodetect).
- Enhanced `ReportViewer` UI/UX: skeleton loading, table scrolling + zebra/hover styles, numeric alignment, and header-title de-duplication; added badge rendering via `renderAs` + `colorMap`.
- Extended `ReportField` typing and passed new field metadata through console report mapping; updated tests and ROADMAP.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Lockfile updated/regenerated; currently drops hotcrm submodule importers and related deps. |
| packages/types/src/reports.ts | Extends `ReportField` with `renderAs` and `colorMap`. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/index.tsx | Exports `formatValue` from the plugin entrypoint. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/formatValue.ts | New formatter for numbers/currency/percent/dates + ISO autodetect. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportViewer.test.tsx | Expanded coverage for formatting, skeleton loading, badges, table UX, and title de-duplication. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/ReportViewer.tsx | Applies formatting + badge rendering; adds skeleton loading and table UX improvements. |
| apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx | Passes `type/format/renderAs/colorMap` through when mapping columns/sections. |
| ROADMAP.md | Adds P4.6 entry documenting this feature work. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

The JSDoc for `colorMap` says “CSS class or color”, but the renderer treats the mapped value strictly as a `className` string on `<Badge>`. This is likely to mislead schema authors into providing raw colors (e.g. `#f00`) that won’t work. Suggest tightening the comment to explicitly state it expects Tailwind/CSS class strings (or extend the renderer to support actual colors via style if that’s intended).
```suggestion
   * Color mapping for badge rendering (value → Tailwind/CSS class name)
   *
   * The mapped string is applied directly as a `className` on the badge component.
   * Use utility classes (e.g., "bg-green-500 text-white") rather than raw colors like "#f00".
```

pnpm-workspace.yaml includes `examples/hotcrm/packages/*`, but this lockfile no longer contains any importer entries for `examples/hotcrm/packages/...`. In CI/Vercel with submodules checked out and `--frozen-lockfile`, installs/builds will fail because the workspace graph doesn’t match the lockfile. Regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml with the hotcrm submodule initialized (e.g., `git submodule update --init examples/hotcrm` then `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile`) so all hotcrm package importers are present.
